name: dexthemes-build-week-video
description: Reproducible Remotion edit for the DexThemes OpenAI Build Week demo.

scripts.render:master: npm run render:master:source && remotion ffmpeg -y -i out/dexthemes-build-week-demo-final-1m35s-source.mp4 -map 0:v:0 -map 0:a:0 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -movflags +faststart out/dexthemes-build-week-demo-final-1m35s.mp4
scripts.render:deepseek:all: npm run render:deepseek:master && npm run render:deepseek:vertical && npm run render:deepseek:square
scripts.render:deepseek:stills: remotion still DeepSeekHarnessReleaseMaster out/deepseek-release/review-master.png --frame=510 && remotion still DeepSeekHarnessReleaseVertical out/deepseek-release/review-vertical.png --frame=930 && remotion still DeepSeekHarnessReleaseSquare out/deepseek-release/review-square.png --frame=930
